Method of Attack: Android spyware that uploads information to threat actors
Hides on device using a gear-shaped icon pretending to be a system component
Requests 18 sensitive permissions including location, camera, SMS, audio recording, storage access
Removes its icon after permissions granted and runs in background with permanent notification
Sends collected data in JSON format to command and control server
Downloads additional payloads via referral system of a Play Store app
Attack Vector: Unknown distribution method, possibly social engineering, phishing, watering hole attacks
Referral system of a popular Play Store app 'Roz Dhan: Earn Wallet cash'
